source.title: Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE dated 04.02.2026, Civil Services Examination, 2026, Appendix I Section III Part A (Preliminary Examination syllabus)

note: Each item is a verbatim bullet of the official Prelims syllabus. The last bullet of Paper II is split at the comma into numeracy and data interpretation; both keep the official wording. The notice gives one flat list per paper, so each paper is one unit.

units.subject: gs-paper-1
units.title: Paper I - (200 marks) Duration: Two hours

items.text: Current events of national and international importance.
History of India and Indian National Movement.
Indian and World Geography-Physical, Social, Economic Geography of India and the World.
Indian Polity and Governance-Constitution, Political System, Panchayati Raj, Public Policy, Rights Issues, etc.
Economic and Social Development-Sustainable Development, Poverty, Inclusion, Demographics, Social Sector Initiatives, etc.
General issues on Environmental ecology, Bio-diversity and Climate Change - that do not require subject specialization.

units.subject: gs-paper-2
units.title: Paper II-(200 marks) Duration: Two hours

items.text: Basic numeracy (numbers and their relations, orders of magnitude, etc.) (Class X level)
Data interpretation (charts, graphs, tables, data sufficiency etc. — Class X level);

open_questions: No concept graph, exam map or coverage report exists for upsc-cse-2026 yet. Prelims GS Paper I spans history, geography, polity, economy, environment and science at the level of 'a well-educated person'; mapping it needs its own NCERT-and-beyond inventory decision.

sources.ref: Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE dated 04.02.2026, Civil Services Examination, 2026, PDF p.32
